grammar: I need to buy some groceries for the week.
en: I need to buy some groceries for the week.
tr: Hafta için biraz yiyecek almam gerek.
ipa: /aɪ nid tu baɪ sʌm ˈgroʊsəriz fɔr ðə wik/
trPron: Ay nid tu bay sam grosıriz for dı vik
collocations: need to buy, buy some groceries
commonMistake: I need to do some food shopping for the week. ✔️
aiExplain: Manav / market alışverişi yapma ihtiyacını belirtme.

grammar: Let's meet at the shopping mall entrance at 2 PM.
en: Let's meet at the shopping mall entrance at 2 PM.
tr: Saat 2'de alışveriş merkezi girişinde buluşalım.
ipa: /lɛts mit æt ðə ˈʃɑpɪŋ mɔl ˈɛntrəns æt tuː piː ɛm/
trPron: Lets mit at dı şopİng mol entrıns at tu pi em
commonMistake: Let's meet at the mall entrance at 2 PM. ✔️

grammar: This clothing store has a sale on all winter coats.
en: This clothing store has a sale on all winter coats.
tr: Bu giyim mağazasında tüm kışlık ceketlerde indirim var.
ipa: /ðɪs ˈkloʊðɪŋ stɔr hæz ə seɪl ɑn ɔl ˈwɪntər koʊts/
trPron: Dis kloudİng stor haz ı seyl on ol vintır kouts
collocations: clothing store has, has a sale
commonMistake: This clothes shop has a sale on all winter coats. ✔️

grammar: I'm looking for a pair of running shoes.
en: I'm looking for a pair of running shoes.
tr: Bir çift koşu ayakkabısı arıyorum.
ipa: /aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr ə pɛr əv ˈrʌnɪŋ ʃuz/
trPron: Aym lukİng for ı per ov runİng şuz
collocations: looking for a, a pair of
commonMistake: I'm looking for a pair of running shoes. ✔️

grammar: I prefer online shopping because it's more convenient.
en: I prefer online shopping because it's more convenient.
tr: Online alışverişi tercih ediyorum çünkü daha pratik.
ipa: /aɪ prɪˈfɜr ˈɑnlaɪn ˈʃɑpɪŋ bɪˈkɔz ɪts mɔr kənˈvinyənt/
trPron: Ay prifır online şopİng bikoz its mor kıvinyint
commonMistake: I prefer shopping online because it's more convenient. ✔️

grammar: Black Friday has the best discounts of the year.
en: Black Friday has the best discounts of the year.
tr: Kara Cuma yılın en iyi indirimlerine sahiptir.
ipa: /blæk ˈfraɪdeɪ hæz ðə bɛst ˈdɪskaʊnts əv ðə jɪr/
trPron: Blek fraydey haz dı best diskauts ov dı yır
commonMistake: Black Friday is the biggest sale of the year. ✔️

grammar: Cyber Monday is great for electronics deals.
en: Cyber Monday is great for electronics deals.
tr: Siber Pazartesi elektronik fırsatları için harikadır.
ipa: /ˈsaɪbər ˈmʌndeɪ ɪz greɪt fɔr ɪˌlɛkˈtrɑnɪks dilz/
trPron: Saybır mandey iz greyt for ilektraniks dilz
collocations: Cyber Monday is, great for electronics
commonMistake: Cyber Monday is a great day for online electronics deals. ✔️
imgQuery: Cyber Monday sale on computer screen

grammar: You can find great bargains at the flea market.
en: You can find great bargains at the flea market.
tr: Bit pazarında harika fırsatlar bulabilirsiniz.
ipa: /juː kæn faɪnd greɪt ˈbɑrgənz æt ðə fli ˈmɑrkɪt/
trPron: Yu ken faynd greyt bargınz at dı fli markıt
collocations: can find great, at the flea
commonMistake: You can find great bargains at the thrift market. ✔️

grammar: I buy fresh vegetables at the farmer's market every Saturday.
en: I buy fresh vegetables at the farmer's market every Saturday.
tr: Her cumartesi pazardan taze sebze alırım.
ipa: /aɪ baɪ frɛʃ ˈvɛʤtəbəlz æt ðə ˈfɑrmərz ˈmɑrkɪt ˈɛvri ˈsætərdeɪ/
trPron: Ay bay freş vectıbıls at dı farmırz markıt evri setırdey
commonMistake: I buy fresh vegetables at the local market every Saturday. ✔️

grammar: The department store has a separate section for children's clothes.
en: The department store has a separate section for children's clothes.
tr: Büyük mağazada çocuk giyim için ayrı bir bölüm var.
ipa: /ðə dɪˈpɑrtmənt stɔr hæz ə ˈsɛpərət ˈsɛkʃən fɔr ˈʧɪldrənz kloʊðz/
trPron: Dı dipartmınt stor haz ı sepırıt sekşın for çıldrınz kloudz
collocations: department store has, has a separate
commonMistake: A department store is usually larger than a regular store. ✔️

grammar: The boutique sells designer clothes that are more expensive.
en: The boutique sells designer clothes that are more expensive.
tr: Butik, daha pahalı olan tasarım kıyafetler satar.
ipa: /ðə buˈtik sɛlz dɪˈzaɪnər kloʊðz ðæt ɑr mɔr ɪkˈspɛnsɪv/
trPron: Dı butik selz dizaynır kloudz det ar mor ikspensiv
commonMistake: The boutique is a small shop that sells designer clothes. ✔️

grammar: Can I return this gift without a receipt?
en: Can I return this gift without a receipt?
tr: Bu hediyeyi fiş olmadan iade edebilir miyim?
ipa: /kæn aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ðɪs gɪft wɪˈðaʊt ə rɪˈsit/
trPron: Ken ay ritörn dis gift vitaut ı risit
collocations: can I return, return this gift
commonMistake: Can I exchange this gift without a receipt? ✔️
aiExplain: Hediyeyi fiş olmadan iade etmek isteme.
imgQuery: person at return counter with gift

grammar: I haven't finished my Christmas shopping yet.
en: I haven't finished my Christmas shopping yet.
tr: Noel alışverişimi henüz bitirmedim.
ipa: /aɪ ˈhævənt ˈfɪnɪʃt maɪ ˈkrɪsməs ˈʃɑpɪŋ jɛt/
trPron: Ay hevınt fİnİşt may krismas şopİng yet
commonMistake: I haven't finished my holiday shopping yet. ✔️

grammar: We went window shopping downtown but didn't buy anything.
en: We went window shopping downtown but didn't buy anything.
tr: Şehir merkezinde vitrin alışverişi yaptık ama hiçbir şey satın almadık.
ipa: /wi wɛnt ˈwɪndoʊ ˈʃɑpɪŋ ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn bʌt ˈdɪdənt baɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ/
trPron: Vi vent vindow şopİng dauntaun bat didınt bay eniİng
commonMistake: We went browsing downtown but didn't buy anything. ✔️

grammar: I made an impulse buy at the checkout counter.
en: I made an impulse buy at the checkout counter.
tr: Kasa önünde dürtüsel bir alışveriş yaptım.
ipa: /aɪ meɪd æn ˈɪmpəls baɪ æt ðə ˈtʃɛkaʊt ˈkaʊntər/
trPron: Ay meyd en impulse bay at dı çekaut kauntır
commonMistake: I made an unplanned purchase at the checkout counter. ✔️

grammar: Buying in bulk is cheaper in the long run.
en: Buying in bulk is cheaper in the long run.
tr: Toplu alım yapmak uzun vadede daha ucuzdur.
ipa: /ˈbaɪɪŋ ɪn bʌlk ɪz ˈʧipər ɪn ðə lɔŋ rʌn/
trPron: Bayİng in bulk iz çipır in dı long ran
collocations: Buying in bulk, in bulk is
commonMistake: Buying wholesale is cheaper in the long run. ✔️

grammar: The price tag says fifty dollars, but it's on sale for forty.
en: The price tag says fifty dollars, but it's on sale for forty.
tr: Fiyat etiketinde elli dolar yazıyor ama kırk dolara indirimde.
ipa: /ðə praɪs tæg sɛz ˈfɪfti ˈdɑlərz bʌt ɪts ɑn seɪl fɔr ˈfɔrti/
trPron: Dı prays teg sez fifti dalırz bat its on seyl for forti
commonMistake: The label says fifty dollars, but it's on sale for forty. ✔️
aiExplain: Fiyat etiketi ile indirimli fiyat arasındaki farkı belirtme.

grammar: The cashier scans the barcode of each item.
en: The cashier scans the barcode of each item.
tr: Kasiyer her ürünün barkodunu okutur.
ipa: /ðə kæˈʃɪr skænz ðə ˈbɑrkoʊd əv iʧ ˈaɪtəm/
trPron: Dı keşir skenz dı barkod ov iç aytım
commonMistake: The cashier scans the price code of each item. ✔️

grammar: Don't forget to bring your shopping list to the store.
en: Don't forget to bring your shopping list to the store.
tr: Alışveriş listenizi mağazaya getirmeyi unutmayın.
ipa: /doʊnt fərˈgɛt tu brɪŋ jʊr ˈʃɑpɪŋ lɪst tu ðə stɔr/
trPron: Dont forgt tu bring yur şopİng list tu dı stor
commonMistake: Don't forget to bring your grocery list to the supermarket. ✔️

grammar: I have a coupon for ten dollars off my purchase.
en: I have a coupon for ten dollars off my purchase.
tr: Alışverişimde on dolar indirim için bir kuponum var.
ipa: /aɪ hæv ə ˈkupɑn fɔr tɛn ˈdɑlərz ɔf maɪ ˈpɜrʧəs/
trPron: Ay hev ı kupın for ten dalırz of may pörças
collocations: have a coupon, coupon for ten
commonMistake: I have a voucher for ten dollars off. ✔️
aiExplain: Kupon ile indirim yapma durumunu anlatma.

grammar: The return policy sign says you have thirty days to return items.
en: The return policy sign says you have thirty days to return items.
tr: İade politikası tabelasında ürünleri iade etmek için otuz gününüz olduğu yazıyor.
ipa: /ðə rɪˈtɜrn ˈpɑləsi saɪn sɛz juː hæv ˈθɜrti deɪz tu rɪˈtɜrn ˈaɪtəmz/
trPron: Dı ritörn palisi sayn sez yu hev thörti deyz tu ritörn aytımz
commonMistake: The store policy says you have thirty days to return items. ✔️

grammar: I prefer using the self-checkout because there's no line.
en: I prefer using the self-checkout because there's no line.
tr: Self-servis ödemeyi tercih ediyorum çünkü sıra yok.
ipa: /aɪ prɪˈfɜr ˈjuzɪŋ ðə sɛlf ˈtʃɛkaʊt bɪˈkɔz ðɛrz noʊ laɪn/
trPron: Ay prifır yuzİng dı self çekaut bikoz derz no layn
commonMistake: I prefer self-service checkout because there's no queue. ✔️

grammar: The checkout line is very long today.
en: The checkout line is very long today.
tr: Bugün kasa sırası çok uzun.
ipa: /ðə ˈtʃɛkaʊt laɪn ɪz ˈvɛri lɔŋ təˈdeɪ/
trPron: Dı çekaut layn iz veri long tudey
collocations: checkout line is, line is very
commonMistake: The checkout queue is very long today. ✔️

grammar: I earned enough loyalty points to get a discount on my next purchase.
en: I earned enough loyalty points to get a discount on my next purchase.
tr: Bir sonraki alışverişimde indirim almak için yeterli sadakat puanı kazandım.
ipa: /aɪ ɜrnd ɪˈnʌf ˈlɔɪəlti pɔɪnts tu gɛt ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɑn maɪ nɛkst ˈpɜrʧəs/
trPron: Ay örnd inaf loyılti poynts tu get ı diskaut on may nekst pörças
commonMistake: I earned enough reward points for a discount on my next purchase. ✔️

grammar: I went on a shopping spree and bought more than I planned.
en: I went on a shopping spree and bought more than I planned.
tr: Bir alışveriş çılgınlığı yaptım ve planladığımdan daha fazla satın aldım.
ipa: /aɪ wɛnt ɑn ə ˈʃɑpɪŋ spri ænd bɔt mɔr ðæn aɪ plænd/
trPron: Ay vent on ı şopİng spri end bot mor den ay pland
collocations: went on a, on a shopping
commonMistake: I splurged on shopping and bought more than I planned. ✔️
